metadata.INTRODUCTION: The following use cases are supported: 1) Key present, with no value (e.g. "passreq" -- password required for this service) 2) Key present, with empty value (e.g. "PlugIns=" server supports plugins, but none are presently installed) 3) Key present, with non-empty value (e.g. "PlugIns=JPEG,MPEG2,MPEG4")

children.name: SdServerCapabilityRecordKey
children.description: Defines a CapabilityRecord key.

children.description: Defines the corresponding CapabilityRecord value.
